topic.title: Chat History Preferences
topic.shortdesc: Configure how chat titles and descriptions are generated in the chat history and how long chats are retained.

body.p: The Chat History preferences page is available in Options Preferences Plugins Oxygen AI Positron Chat History . It contains the following options:

dlentry.dt: Automatically generate chat title and description using AI

dd.p: When this option is selected (the default), the AI generates the title and description used to identify each chat in the chat history in the background. It generates them from the first message you send, in the same language as that message. Titles contain no more than 50 characters.
For a chat that you start by running an action, the title and description are generated from the action and the content on which you ran it.

Until the AI returns the title and description, the chat is listed by its first message. If this option is not selected, the first message is used as both the title and description. You can rename a chat at any time in the chat history.

dlentry.dd: Specifies the AI model used to generate titles and descriptions. This option is available only when the Automatically generate chat title and description using AI option is selected. The drop-down list contains models from all enabled connections, including AI Positron Service models if the service is enabled. If no model is selected or the selected model is no longer available, the model currently used by the chat is used.

dlentry.dt: Delete chats not changed for more than (days)
dlentry.dd:
When this option is selected (the default), conversations in the current project that have not changed for the specified number of days are deleted from the chat history. The default is 365 days. You can specify a value from 1 through 9999. To retain conversations indefinitely, clear this option.
Deleted conversations are moved to the Recycle Bin (or Trash on macOS) if the operating system supports it. Otherwise, they are permanently deleted. The number of days is calculated from the date of the last change in whole calendar days: only the day of the last change matters, not its time. For example, with a value of 30, a conversation last changed on September 19, at any time, is retained through October 19 and can be deleted starting on October 20.Old conversations are deleted in the background when the application starts, when a project is opened, or when you change this option or its value and click OK or Apply. If the change would delete conversations, a confirmation dialog box reports how many conversations will be deleted. If you click Cancel, no conversations are deleted at that time. However, the new setting is retained and applied the next time the application starts or the project is opened. The same confirmation appears when you open a project whose project options retain conversations for fewer days.
The number of days can be stored in the project options so that everyone working on the project uses the same value. When you open a project that retains conversations for fewer days than the previous setting, you are asked to confirm the deletion before any conversations are removed.
